recipes.name: Download a file
recipes.summary: The plain fetch. Saves the file under its own name in the current directory.
recipes.cost: As long as the transfer takes.

recipes.name: Download quietly to a name
recipes.summary: No progress output, written to a filename you choose. Good for scripts and shells.
recipes.when: You are pulling a file onto a target through a shell and want it named.
recipes.cost: As long as the transfer takes.

recipes.name: Resume a broken download
recipes.summary: Continue a partial file instead of starting over.

recipes.name: Mirror a site
recipes.summary: Recursively download a whole site, following links, converting them for offline viewing.
recipes.when: You want a local copy of a site to read or grep offline.
recipes.cost: Potentially large — it follows every link under the path.
recipes.warn: Mirroring hits many URLs. Scope it with --no-parent and a sensible --level.

recipes.name: Check a link without downloading
recipes.summary: Act as a spider: check that a URL exists, pull headers, but do not save anything.
recipes.when: You want to confirm a path or read its headers without fetching the body.

recipes.name: Ignore a certificate error
recipes.summary: Download over HTTPS even when the certificate does not validate.
recipes.when: A self-signed or expired certificate blocks a download you still want.
recipes.warn: Disabling the certificate check removes the integrity guarantee. Only when you accept that.

recipes.name: Download with HTTP auth
recipes.summary: Supply a username and password for a basic-auth protected file.
recipes.when: The file is behind HTTP basic authentication.

recipes.name: Set a user-agent and headers
recipes.summary: Identify as a chosen user-agent and add a header, for a server that filters on them.
recipes.when: The server rejects the default wget user-agent.
